::: {.callout-tip title="The contract, before you write any code"}
This is the server's own `/docs` page — a static copy of it, served from this
site. Three things are worth doing with it before class:

- **Notice that nobody wrote it.** Every field name, type, example value and
  error shape below was generated from the `Flower` class. That is what "the
  schema *is* the API" means in practice.
- **Open `POST /predict` and read the example request.** It is pre-filled with
  `6.0, 2.7, 5.0, 1.7` — a real flower on the versicolor/virginica boundary.
  The three response cards underneath show what the server actually returns for
  it, and why the contract carries a confidence and not just a label.
- **Look at the 422.** It is in the contract as a documented response, not an
  accident. Pydantic rejects a bad request before `predict()` is ever called.

There is no *Try it out* button here, because there is no server behind a static
page. You get the live version by running your own — `uvicorn
server_skeleton:app --reload`, then `127.0.0.1:8000/docs`. It is this page plus
a send button, and getting there is Block 3.
:::
